comment: Hashes are FNV-1a 32-bit. MODULES ('kind':'module') hash the exact ModuleScript Source bytes. TEMPLATES ('kind':'template') hash a CANONICAL SERIALISATION of a GuiObject subtree (sorted children, whitelisted+sorted properties, attributes, tags; ViewportFrame 3D contents excluded) -- see docs/decisions/ADR-0005-instance-tree-hashing.md. tools/hash_shared.luau computes both inside Studio and marks template hashes with a trailing '*'. 'deployed' records the hash last verified in each Place; null = not yet deployed. Any mismatch between file hash and a deployed hash = DRIFT: stop and reconcile before working on shared systems.

ProfileTemplate.comment: SCHEMA_VERSION=2 (A1, 2026-08-01): Towers(towerId) -> Units(uuid) instances, Currency -> Currencies map, +PlayerLevel/Loadout/Pity/Counters/Quests/LoginStreak/ShopStock/Titles/Spirits/Battlepass; Migrations[1] converts v1->v2. STORE_NAME stays Beta1_PlayerData(Dev1). Deployed byte-identical (63a0c98a) in GAME (A1) and LOBBY (A2, 2026-08-01) -- drift-green in both Places. Prior hashes: 184cdfad = beta store rename (v1), 8ac5d3e9 = starter-seed removal (v1), 376e717d = original v1.

Signal.comment: Lua-side pub/sub used by PlayerDataService. Promoted into shared canon 2026-07-17 (AD-Lobby session) from the verified live Game source; covered by the shared/src deploys row in OWNERSHIP.md (owner AD-Game).

TierConfig.comment: Promoted to shared canon 2026-08-01 (A-phase Integration). RECONCILED from two predecessors: the Game's A3 TierConfig (Order/SortOrder + PascalCase API) and the Lobby's interim TierConfig (multi-colour palettes + ColorSequence helpers, incl. Mythic rainbow / Secret red+dark-red). Every tier authors a Colors LIST; .Color is derived from Colors[1]. Both predecessors are REPLACED.

StatGradeConfig.comment: Promoted to shared canon 2026-08-01 (A-phase Integration), byte-identical to the A3 original. Maps a 0..1 roll to D..Apex. The Lobby needs it to grade rolls WITHOUT tower configs - grades come from the roll alone.

AscensionConfig.comment: Promoted to shared canon 2026-08-01 (A-phase Integration), byte-identical to the A3 original. Required by the Game's TowerStatResolver; the Lobby displays ascension level.

ItemCatalog.comment: Promoted to shared canon 2026-08-01 (A-phase Integration). THE authority on a grantable's Name/Tier/Icon; replaces the Lobby's interim UnitCatalog for name+tier. CHANGED at promotion: the TowerConfigRegistry require is now LAZY + OPTIONAL so the module loads in the Lobby (which has no tower configs); Validate() returns (ok, errors, notes) and reports the skipped Tower->TowerConfig cross-check. Added GetName/GetTier convenience readers.

UnitStatsCatalog.comment: GENERATED cache of per-tower RESOLVED base stats (DMG/RNG/SPA at tier1/ML1/no-trait/mid-roll/asc0) so the Lobby fills the Units-screen number slots without the full stat stack (ADR-0003). Added A6 2026-08-03 (owner AD-Game). Load-bearing validator SSS.Server.UnitStatsCatalogValidate regenerates from the live tower configs at boot in the Game place and errors LOUD on drift -- it stays GAME-ONLY canon (the Lobby has no tower configs to validate against). Deployed byte-identical (3bb9b140) in GAME (A6) and LOBBY (A6b, 2026-08-06) -- drift-green 9/9 in both Places. Regenerate + rehash whenever a tower's Damage/Range/SPA or BaseStats changes.

UIKitButton.comment: Kit CONTROLLER. ONE reusable behaviour controller for every GuiButton (hover scale/stroke/icon-rotate, press, seamless animated gradient); all tuning via Attributes. Tag any GuiButton 'UIKitButton' and UIKitBootstrap attaches it. Promoted to shared canon 2026-08-06 with the rest of the kit so the Game place can build on it (blueprint section 9 A6).

UIKitItemIcon.comment: Kit CONTROLLER. Item card: flat ImageLabel icon (items have no model, so NO ViewportFrame), QtyBadge that hides at qty 0, tier border/BG from the shared TierConfig. Requires Configs.Meta.{ItemCatalog,TierConfig} -- both already shared. Promoted 2026-08-06.

UIKitFilterPanel.comment: Kit CONTROLLER. Reusable filter panel (GroupTemplate + ToggleTemplate + Apply/Reset/Cancel, pending-vs-applied state). Used by BOTH the Units and Items screens in the Lobby. Promoted 2026-08-06.

UIKitBootstrap.comment: Kit CONTROLLER (LocalScript, not a ModuleScript -- still hashed as source). Attaches UIKit.Button to every instance tagged 'UIKitButton', including clones added later. Without this in a Place, tagged buttons are inert. Promoted 2026-08-06.

Kit_UnitIcon.comment: Kit TEMPLATE (the blueprint section 5 UnitIcon: ViewportFrame + BG/tier border + TraitIcon + LevelBadge + CostLabel + NameLabel + ShinyBadge, plus KeyLabel/CountLabel that default HIDDEN for the hotbar). A6 2026-08-06: renamed from the A5 leftover 'Unit/ItemIconTemplate' (which had zero readers) and put to work as the Game hotbar slot. Built by running one IDENTICAL deterministic script in BOTH Places and hash-matching the result -- the base tree was verified identical (be620746) first. ViewportFrame 3D contents are not hashed (ADR-0005).

UIKitRewardPopup.comment: Kit CONTROLLER. Reward-reveal popup: takes CATALOG IDS and resolves name/tier/icon from the shared ItemCatalog + TierConfig, so callers need no art or naming logic. An id that is NOT in the catalog still renders (falls back to the id, tier Common) rather than erroring -- a reward the player earned must never fail to display. A6 2026-08-06. NO CALLER YET BY DESIGN: MatchEnd keeps its own working rewards list (user decision); this exists for Phase B gacha and was smoke-tested, not wired.

Kit_RewardPopup.comment: Kit TEMPLATE (dark Overlay + Panel with Title/Subtitle + Grid + RewardItemTemplate + CloseButton, blueprint section 5). Built by one identical deterministic script run in BOTH Places and hash-matched. A6 2026-08-06.

LoadoutConfig.comment: Hotbar slot count (6) + per-slot account-level unlocks {1,1,1,5,20,50} + helpers. SHARED because both Places draw the same 6 slots and the same locks -- if only one knew, the two hotbars would disagree. Written by AD-UI 2026-08-06 with the user's authorisation; owner is AD-Lobby (it gates a profile write). Verified Lv1->3 slots, Lv5->4, Lv20->5, Lv50->6.

Kit_HotbarSlot.comment: Kit TEMPLATE: the USER'S OWN hotbar slot design, lifted from the Lobby's Slot1 so BOTH Places draw an identical slot (user rule 2026-08-06: same look, different action). Adds LockOverlay (dark + lock icon + 'Lv N') and SlotNumber; the broken legacy per-slot script was stripped. GAME DEPLOY PENDING -- the user copy/pastes it, then hashes must match.

templatesNote: Templates are under drift control since 2026-08-06 (ADR-0005). They have NO shared/src file: the Instance is the canon. Two safe ways to get one into another Place: COPY it (Studio copy/paste) and prove equality by hash, OR build it with an identical DETERMINISTIC script run in both Places and hash-match (used for Kit_UnitIcon). Never rebuild by hand/by eye. See tools/checklists.md.
